title: Developments That Led To Home Rule League
definition: The Home Rule Movement (1916–1918) was India's response to wartime repression and political stagnation, emerging as a transition from the Moderate-Extremist split to militant, organized nationalist agitation modeled on the Irish Home Rule movement.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the evolution of the Indian National Movement from the Surat Split (1907) to the Lucknow Pact (1916) and Montagu Declaration (1917), testing analytical capabilities on political vacuum, wartime exhaustion, and leadership resurgence.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Developments That Led To Home Rule League.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Rise of Extremism and Surat Split (1907)
